activity.notes: Tata official organizational chronology identifies Ratan Naval Tata taking chair March 25, 1991 and stepping down December 2012; covers restructuring and major international acquisitions. This is a corporate leadership TERM and never governs India. Do not conflate Ratan Naval Tata (1937–2024) with Sir Ratan Tata (1871–1918), Tata founder Jamsetji or J. R. D. Tata.
